title: Maximal points of affine opens are ambient closed points
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $X$ be a scheme locally of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. If $U\subseteq X$ is an affine open subscheme [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and $x\in U$ is a closed point of $U$ [def-weil-closed-points], then $x$ is a closed point of $X$ [def-weil-closed-points].

source.place: Tag 0478 (lemma-locally-finite-type-Jacobson): a scheme locally of finite type over a field is Jacobson, so closed points of an affine open are closed in the ambient scheme
